lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Plate 2 to flange 3, 90 deg with a clean radius. At the 25/50/75% sections the line sits on the outer-skin apex (0.08/0.18/0.24 mm to the nearest surface point). It runs u -40.1..40.5 against a flange of u -40.4..40.5, so it covers the full fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Flange 3 to strip 8, a 28 deg formed kink with a radius; it is the first bend of the joggle and well over 10 deg. The line is on the convex (outer) apex at every section, 0.16-0.29 mm from the nearest point, and spans the strip's length.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Strip 7 to lip 5, a 44 deg formed kink with a radius; it is the second bend of the joggle, with a flat strip of about 5 mm between the two kinks. The line is on the outer apex, 0.13-0.17 mm from the nearest point, and covers u -41.2..41.1, which is the whole strip.

lines.label: B4
lines.reason: Flange 3 to end wall 9 at u=+42, 90 deg. Sections at constant height (n=2, -5, -10.5) show a smooth radius of about 2 mm, and the line is on the outer corner apex. The line runs n 3.0..-11.1, between the corner relief at the plate seam (n about 4.6) and the relief at B2 (n about -11.5), which is about 89% of the visible fold. Below the B2 relief the strip and wall meet in a stepped, sharp junction; that is not a continuation of the fold.

lines.label: B5
lines.reason: This is the mirror of B4 at u=-42 (flange 3 to end wall 10, 90 deg). The radius is clear in the sections, the line is on the outer apex (0.13-0.21 mm), and it spans between the two round corner reliefs that are visible on the corner close-ups.

lines.label: B6
lines.reason: End wall 12 to eared tab 16, a 90 deg formed fold with a radius in all three sections. The line is on the outer apex (0.18-0.24 mm) and spans the full width of the tab root in the face-on and oblique close-ups.

lines.label: B7
lines.reason: This is the mirror of B6 (end wall 11 to eared tab 14, 90 deg, with a radius). The line is on the outer apex (0.15-0.30 mm) and covers the tab root from about n=-1.9 to -14.5.
